explanation_full:
The incremental feature analysis shows that the KNN model achieves the highest R² (0.81717) and lowest MSE (0.012810) when using all 11 features: VFA, Butyrate, Acetate, VSS, Propionate, Ethanol, COD-O, pH, ORP_Low, ORP_Mid, and Sucrose_Degradation. This suggests that these features collectively contribute significantly to predicting hydrogen production.

The model performance improves incrementally as more features are added, indicating the importance of considering a comprehensive set of variables for accurate prediction.
